name: Schrodinger's Catgirl
source:
[IS THE GIRL IN THE MANOR ALIVE OR DEAD?]

June 16, 2016. Last night, a girl was mauled while trying to sneak into the abandoned Hayes manor. The Luminous Investigation Team - Lemi Malloy and Leon Gaspar - have been called in to find the source.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1460950/]Steam[/url]]
